Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's CEO, effective immediately.

Nvidia says he also left as president and from the board. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent one. Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993.

Shares fell as much as 14% at Thursday's open (AP). Nvidia has not given a reason. On Sunday it opened an independent investigation into reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation.

What to watch: Nvidia still reports earnings on Tuesday, November 17. This is news, not investment advice.

Sources: Nvidia, AP, Yahoo Finance, Fox Business.
